items.title: ChatGPT Ads introduces new measurement tools and visual ad formats
items.excerpt: OpenAI is adding Northbeam, DV Rockerbox and INCRMNTAL plus Kochava, Tenjin and Airbridge as measurement partners, redesigning the Ads Manager Conversions page, sending weekly performance emails, and testing larger images, wider ad cards and a multi-image format. This follows up the Oct 8 image-generation ad format already covered, so it needs a new angle. Article HTML is blocked; facts come from the SEL RSS full text.

items.title: Google begins testing ads in AI Mode for users with Personal Intelligence enabled
items.excerpt: Google is reversing the ad-free Personal Intelligence experience and testing AI Mode ads that can be personalized with insights from connected Google apps. Ads won't be based directly on Gmail or Photos content, and advertisers get no access to connected-app data. Facts come from the SEL RSS full text because the article HTML is blocked.

items.title: How ChatGPT Targets Ads To You Based On Your Prompts, Phone Number, and Email
items.excerpt: 404 Media reports that advertisers can target ChatGPT users by uploaded email address, phone number or mobile ad ID, on top of prompt context, which most users likely don't realize. This is an off-list outlet: AdExchanger's roundup cites it and no on-list outlet covered it.

items.title: Thrad commits $1m in ad spend to AI chat apps testing in-chat ads
items.excerpt: Thrad's Monetization Fund II routes up to $1 million in advertiser campaigns through its DSP to consumer AI apps willing to test in-chat ads, double the $500,000 first round. Ads are matched to the conversation topic rather than a user profile and appear as disclosed native sponsored placements.

items.title: Meta's New Terms Expand Crawling Rights Beyond Advertisers
items.excerpt: Meta's new commercial terms, effective Oct 30, let it crawl any site tied to a Facebook or Instagram business account and use the content to train its AI products, widening rights ad buyers had already granted. Meta says the purpose is product data, which ties it to AI product ads and shopping. The Verge and PPC Land also covered it.

items.title: Google Ads PM says target or budget changes cause no learning period
items.excerpt: Google Ads PM Tal Akabas said on Oct 15 that Smart Bidding scales bids in proportion to new targets on steady campaigns, so target or budget changes don't trigger a learning period. Re-engagement mode has reached PMax, with Search and Shopping next.

items.title: Meta's Muse gains a 33% share of AI browser traffic in 9 days, DataDome finds
items.excerpt: DataDome counted 29.1 million Muse requests in 12 days, 99.3% of them from Cloudflare and Fastly rather than home ISPs, which puts merchants' bot rules to the test. This is a follow-up to the HUMAN '72% of agent traffic' story already covered and offers new vendor data only.

items.title: Square's First Standalone Kiosk Features An AI Ordering Assistant
items.excerpt: Square's $1,999 flagship kiosk (plus $99/month) has a conversational voice layer that understands a seller's menu, answers questions, suggests items based on time of day or cart contents, and handles modifications. Adweek notes the screens won't carry ads. The Verge also covered it.

items.title: Pivot or Perish: Kargo's Bet on AI Media Buying
items.excerpt: In this interview, Kargo CEO Harry Kargman describes Karlo, a chat-style AI media buying platform for mid-market and smaller brands. Users upload assets, brand guidelines, audience data and media plans, then plan and launch campaigns with it. The piece is a podcast interview, not a launch release.

items.title: VideoAmp Bets On AI To Connect Ad Planning And Measurement
items.excerpt: VideoAmp says connecting its planning and measurement workflows to AI agents is a top priority, so buyers can optimize TV campaigns in flight. It cut about 20% of staff over the summer to shift operations to AI. Weak: there is no named product, launch date or customer data.

items.title: AI 광고부터 해외 진출까지…'틱톡 서밋 코리아 2026' 개최
items.excerpt: At TikTok Summit Korea 2026 on Oct 20, TikTok will cover ad creative with Symphony, its generative AI tool, Smart+ campaign automation, its agentic AI direction, and a demo of making ad video with the Seedance 2.5 model, plus TikTok Shop cross-border selling. This is an event preview (off-list Korean outlet).

items.title: G마켓, 셀러 컨퍼런스 개최…"신규 쿠폰 정책·AI 에이전트 도입"
items.excerpt: At its 2026 seller conference (Oct 13–14, about 1,000 sellers), Gmarket laid out support plans for its 660,000 sellers, including AI agents for shopping and seller sales management and a new coupon policy. Off-list Korean outlet; the body text was thin, so the summary relies on the meta description and headlines.

items.title: "AI비서가 쇼핑부터 결제까지" 농협카드, 안랩과 '에이전틱 페이먼트' 실증추진
items.excerpt: NH NongHyup Card and AhnLab Blockchain Company are running an Agentic Payment PoC: an AI assistant finds and picks products based on conditions the customer sets, pays automatically in stablecoin over the x402 protocol, and the card company verifies and settles. Possible NH pay integration later. Off-list Korean outlet.

items.title: AI가 바꾼 디지털 마케팅 공식… 장윤석 네이버 실장 "운영보다 전략, 클릭보다 맥락"
items.excerpt: At the Oct 15 KODA AI ad marketing seminar, Naver and Kakao said AI will automate much of ad operations. Naver pointed to AI Briefing and its AI tab beta, which links to Maps, Place and Shopping so search carries through to purchases and bookings. This is a seminar recap (off-list Korean outlet); MADTimes covered the same event.
